subject: Observability onboarding + ops roadmap for BrightEdge: dashboards, traces, alert routing
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@brightedge.com>, BrightEdge Ops <ops@brightedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability onboarding + ops roadmap for BrightEdge: dashboards, traces, alert routing

Hi Sara / BrightEdge team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference observability. Attached is our kickoff runbook draft (RBW-BrightEdge-Onboard-Runbook-v1.docx) and an initial agenda + day-of checklist. High-level goals for this engagement:

- Deliver dashboard templates for latency, error-rate, throughput, and model-quality signals by Oct 10
- Wire tracing hooks into your inference calls and validate spans in staging by Oct 12
- Implement alert-routing matrix to send P1/P2 to Ops Slack and P3 to Email by Oct 14
- Provide an agreed runbook with on-call play and escalation steps before go-live

Questions for you:
1) Are there any IP / network allowlist constraints we should know about (we added a sample CSV attachment for your team to confirm)?
2) Who should be the day-of primary on your side for incident triage (ops@ or a named engineer)?
3) Any dashboards beyond the four above you want prioritized?

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Oct 3: Tracing hooks sample deployed to staging (Ben/Monica to lead)
- Oct 5: Dashboard review session (30–45m)
- Oct 12: Runbook dry-run + alert routing verification

Ben and Monica will own the technical delivery; I will run the project cadence and stakeholder communications.

Attachments: RBW-BrightEdge-Onboard-Runbook-v1.docx; network-allowlist.csv

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@brightedge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightEdge Ops <ops@brightedge.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightedge.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding + ops roadmap for BrightEdge: dashboards, traces, alert routing

Laura —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers inline:

1) Network allowlist: attached is our egress CIDR list (network-allowlist.csv) and the security team will open a ticket if anything else is required.
2) Day-of primary: Tom Ellis (cc'd) will own triage. He will forward to the right SRE if needed.
3) Dashboards: please add a model-degradation panel (embedding drift / top-k accuracy) in addition to latency/error/throughput — that one is important for our product team.

We have a procurement question: our vendor onboarding requires a short SOC2 attestation and an MSA amendment. I'll route those to procurement next.

Let's keep Oct 5 for the dashboard session.

Thanks,
Sara
Senior Engineering Manager, BrightEdge
sara.nguyen@brightedge.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@brightedge.com>, BrightEdge Ops <ops@brightedge.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding + ops roadmap for BrightEdge: dashboards, traces, alert routing

Thanks Laura / Sara —

I've uploaded a first-pass runbook checklist and an alert-routing matrix (attached as alert-routing-matrix.xlsx). High-level notes:

- Dashboards: will add the model-degradation panel; need an example metric (embedding drift signal) from BrightEdge or we can use a proxy for the dry-run.
- Tracing: our recommended span schema is in section 3 of the runbook; expected attributes: request_id, model_version, input_size, token_count, latency_ms. We will provide a lightweight client snippet for Node/Python.
- Alerts: propose P1 -> Ops Slack #brightedge-ops + SMS escalation; P2 -> Ops Slack + Email; P3 -> Email only. See attached matrix for routing and thresholds.

Attachments: RBW-BrightEdge-Onboard-Runbook-v1.docx (annotated), alert-routing-matrix.xlsx

Next steps for internal owners:
- Monica: push tracing snippet to staging environment by Oct 3 and validate sample spans.
- Aditya: prepare dashboard templates and mapping to BrightEdge metrics by Oct 5.

I'll schedule the dashboard review once Aditya has templates ready.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@brightedge.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Action items and owner assignments — BrightEdge onboarding

Team —

Following up to make the owner assignments explicit so we have a single source of responsibility: 

- Tracing & span validation (staging): Monica Patel — deliverable: tracing-hook-snippet.patch + validation log sample by EOD Oct 3.
- Dashboards (templates + model-degradation panel): Aditya Rao — deliverable: Grafana dashboard JSON + mapping doc by Oct 5.
- Alerts & runbook write-up: Ben Carter — deliverable: finalized runbook + alert-routing-matrix.xlsx updated by Oct 8.
- Communication & go/no-go coordination: Laura Bennett — will run the Oct 12 dry-run and collect sign-offs.

Stephanie, I'll loop you in on the go/no-go checklist — please confirm the escalation window metrics and who will be on-call from the enterprise CS roster for the Oct 12 dry-run.

I'll also post a lightweight timeline in the shared Drive link so BrightEdge can comment directly.

Laura
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@brightedge.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Oct 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action items and owner assignments — BrightEdge onboarding

Quick status: pushed tracing-hook-snippet.patch to the staging repo and validated example spans. Key details:

- Sample span fields: request_id (string), model_version (semver), input_tokens (int), output_tokens (int), compute_latency_ms (float), error_code (nullable).
- Collector endpoint: staging-collector.brightedge.redwood-internal:5566 (we validated ingest and can see sample traces in the trace viewer).
- I added a minimal instrumentation checklist to the runbook section 3.2 (see RBW-BrightEdge-Onboard-Runbook-v1.docx annotated).

Attachment: tracing-hook-snippet.patch

Monica
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@brightedge.com>, BrightEdge Ops <ops@brightedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: BrightEdge go/no-go checklist and Oct 12 dry-run confirmation

Sara / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround this week. Per our run-through the team is ready to execute the Oct 12 dry-run. Summary of the pre-reqs (all checked):

- Network allowlist confirmed by BrightEdge security (network-allowlist.csv) — OK
- Tracing hooks deployed to staging and sample spans validated — OK (Monica)
- Dashboard templates (latency, error-rate, throughput, model-degradation) available — OK (Aditya)
- Alert routing matrix drafted and agreed on initial recipients — OK (Ben)
- Procurement (SOC2 attestation) is in flight per Sara — pending but not blocking dry-run

Oct 12 dry-run plan (30–45 min):
- 10m: quick recap and roles
- 15m: induce a benign error in staging to validate alert firing + routing
- 10m: review trace for that request and confirm span attributes
- 5m: acceptance and next steps (go/no-go for limited production ramp)

Can you confirm Tom Ellis will be on the dry-run call as the BrightEdge triage lead? If yes, I'll send calendar invite with dial-in and runbook link.

Attachments: final runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/brightedge/onboarding/RBW-BrightEdge-Onboard-Runbook-v1

Looking forward —
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
